hook: Fifteen questions, no second chances. Can you score fifteen out of fifteen? Let us find out.

questions.question: What gas do plants take in from the air for photosynthesis?
questions.question_speech: Question one. What gas do plants take in from the air for photosynthesis? A. Oxygen. B. Nitrogen. C. Carbon dioxide. D. Hydrogen.

questions.question: What is water made of?
questions.question_speech: Question two. What is water made of? A. Hydrogen and oxygen. B. Carbon and oxygen. C. Nitrogen and hydrogen. D. Helium and oxygen.
questions.answer_speech: A is correct, hydrogen and oxygen.

questions.question: What is the center of an atom called?
questions.question_speech: Question three. What is the center of an atom called? A. Electron. B. Nucleus. C. Shell. D. Orbit.

questions.question: What force pulls objects toward the Earth?
questions.question_speech: Question four. What force pulls objects toward the Earth? A. Magnetism. B. Friction. C. Gravity. D. Inertia.

questions.question: At sea level, water boils at what temperature?
questions.question_speech: Question five. At sea level, water boils at what temperature? A. 90 degrees Celsius. B. 80 degrees Celsius. C. 120 degrees Celsius. D. 100 degrees Celsius.

questions.question: What is the hardest natural substance?
questions.question_speech: Question six. What is the hardest natural substance? A. Diamond. B. Gold. C. Iron. D. Quartz.

questions.question: Which travels faster, light or sound?
questions.question_speech: Question seven. Which travels faster, light or sound? A. Sound. B. Light. C. They are equal. D. It depends on the day.

questions.question: Which gas makes up most of Earth's atmosphere?
questions.question_speech: Question eight. Which gas makes up most of Earth's atmosphere? A. Oxygen. B. Carbon dioxide. C. Nitrogen. D. Hydrogen.

questions.question: What do we call animals that eat only plants?
questions.question_speech: Question nine. What do we call animals that eat only plants? A. Carnivores. B. Omnivores. C. Insectivores. D. Herbivores.

questions.question: What is the process plants use to make their food?
questions.question_speech: Question ten. What is the process plants use to make their food? A. Photosynthesis. B. Digestion. C. Respiration. D. Evaporation.

questions.question: At what temperature does water freeze, in degrees Celsius?
questions.question_speech: Question eleven. At what temperature does water freeze, in degrees Celsius? A. Ten. B. Zero. C. Minus ten. D. One hundred.

questions.question: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
questions.question_speech: Question twelve. Which metal is liquid at room temperature? A. Iron. B. Copper. C. Mercury. D. Aluminum.

questions.question: Who developed the theory of relativity?
questions.question_speech: Question thirteen. Who developed the theory of relativity? A. Isaac Newton. B. Albert Einstein. C. Galileo Galilei. D. Nikola Tesla.

questions.question: Which gas do humans need to breathe to live?
questions.question_speech: Question fourteen. Which gas do humans need to breathe to live? A. Oxygen. B. Helium. C. Carbon dioxide. D. Methane.

questions.question: What is the study of living things called?
questions.question_speech: Question fifteen. What is the study of living things called? A. Geology. B. Chemistry. C. Physics. D. Biology.
